hotel.name: The Beach Club at The Boca Raton

verified_facts.text: Beach Club is the oceanfront part of The Boca Raton, a beachside setting that connects inside and out.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beach Club provides a beachside escape that seamlessly connects inside and out to awaken your senses.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club has three private pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embrace the art of relaxation in our three private pools, half a mile of private golden beach, and luxury cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club has half a mile of private golden beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embrace the art of relaxation in our three private pools, half a mile of private golden beach, and luxury cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club offers luxury cabanas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embrace the art of relaxation in our three private pools, half a mile of private golden beach, and luxury cabanas.

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites are designed with honed marble and cerused woods with vibrant coral velvet accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spacious guest rooms and suites showcase a spectacular design featuring honed marble and cerused woods complemented by vibrant coral velvet accents.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have natural textures, open light-filled spaces and floor-to-ceiling views of the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The natural textures and open, light-filled spaces invite you to connect with seaside nature through to floor-to-ceiling views of the turquoise blue ocean waters

verified_facts.text: Suites come in one- and two-bedroom options with expansive outdoor spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover suites, featuring one and two-bedroom options with variations of expansive outdoor spaces, granting guests easy access to the fresh salt air.

verified_facts.text: Room types include Ocean View rooms with a balcony, and suites such as the Grand Suite + Lanai and the Ocean View Studio Suite + Terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ocean View + Balcony

verified_facts.text: Marisol serves Mediterranean fare overlooking the ocean in an indoor-outdoor setting with an expansive covered terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Where fresh Mediterranean fare is savored overlooking the ocean, Marisol is Beach Club’s popular culinary destination, now better than ever. In a newly designed indoor-outdoor setting with an expansive covered terrace

verified_facts.text: Marisol's menu features fresh seafood delivered daily by local fishermen, with shellfish towers and raw bar options.
verified_facts.excerpt: the menu will showcase an abundance of fresh seafood delivered daily by local fisherman via vibrant shellfish towers and raw bar options

verified_facts.text: Onda is a seasonal sand-side restaurant steps from the ocean that opens each winter season, spotlighting a new chef each season.
verified_facts.excerpt: Onda will open each winter season spotlighting a new culinary mastermind

verified_facts.text: Marisol is exclusive to Members and hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusive to Members and hotel guests.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club offers poolside and beachside food and beverage service, the Sand Bar and Ocean Market.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pools & Beach, Cabanas, Poolside and beachside food and beverage service, Sand Bar, and Ocean Market.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club suite guests are part of The Boca Raton Suite Collection, along with suite guests of Tower and Yacht Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Boca Raton Suite Collection offers an added layer of exclusivity and access for suite guests of Tower, Yacht Club, and Beach Club.

verified_facts.text: Beach Club Suite Collection guests get afternoon and evening access to Top of the Tower with complimentary lunch and dinner bites and drinks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to Top of the Tower from 1:00 to 7:00 pm with complimentary lunch and dinner bites, and drinks.

verified_facts.text: Top of the Tower is a private 27th-floor lounge with sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and the South Florida coastline.
verified_facts.excerpt: a private lounge in a coveted setting on the 27th floor with sweeping views of the Atlantic Ocean and South Florida coastline

verified_facts.text: Top of the Tower was once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay's first North American outpost.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once home to Chef Gordon Ramsay’s first North American outpost, Top of the Tower has been reimagined as an exclusive 27th-floor lounge

verified_facts.text: Suite Collection benefits include priority dining reservations, VIP check-in, and priority pool and beach seating.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Suite Collection provides exclusive benefits throughout the resort, including priority dining reservations, VIP check-in, and priority pool and beach seating

verified_facts.text: Suite Collection guests have a dedicated floor butler team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our dedicated floor butler team is at your disposal

verified_facts.text: Suite Collection guests have exclusive access to curated experiences such as Monkey Sunday Brunch, mid-day Discover Cruises and a curated cocktail demo.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suite Collection guests also have exclusive access to a curated calendar of experiences, such as:

verified_facts.text: Daytime dress code at the beachside restaurants is Beach Elegant, with shirts, cover-ups and footwear required.
verified_facts.excerpt: Daytime Attire: Beach Elegant. Shirts, cover-ups and footwear required.
